notes: A new folder, as in /api/folders; only admins see it until people are given it. Its directory on the drive is its name, made safe for file systems, with a number when taken: <storage_dir>/Wedding Anna & Marco. The name is 1 to 60 characters and can't look like a date (2026-09-27), else 400 bad_request; 409 folder_name_taken if another folder has it, ignoring case.
